# EDTF v2.0.0 - Table of Contents

> Extended Date Time Format (EDTF) / ISO 8601-2 parsing and English language rendering

## Pages

- [EDTF](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [EDTF](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.md): Parse, validate, and humanize EDTF date strings

- [EDTF.Aggregate](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Aggregate.md): Parser for EDTF Lists and Sets

- [EDTF.Continuation](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Continuation.md): EDTF Continuation Struct

- [EDTF.Date](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Date.md): Parser for basic EDTF dates, including year, and decade

- [EDTF.DateRange](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.DateRange.md): Convert parsed EDTF structs into a `{start_date, end_date}` tuple of
`Date.t()` values suitable for SQL- or Ecto-style range queries.
- [EDTF.Humanize](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Humanize.md): Convert EDTF dates to human readable form

- [EDTF.Humanize.Aggregate](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Humanize.Aggregate.md): Humanize EDTF Set and List types

- [EDTF.Humanize.Date](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Humanize.Date.md): Humanize EDTF Date, Year, Decade, Century, and Season types

- [EDTF.Infinity](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Infinity.md): EDTF Infinity struct

- [EDTF.Interval](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Interval.md): Parser for EDTF Intervals

- [EDTF.Level](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Level.md): Utility functions to add the correct level to `%EDTF.Date` structs

- [EDTF.Parser](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Parser.md): NimbleParsec parser for EDTF dates

- [EDTF.Parser.Helpers](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Parser.Helpers.md): Helper functions for parsing EDTF dates

- [EDTF.Validate](https://edtf.hexdocs.pm/EDTF.Validate.md): Calendar validation for assembled EDTF structs.
